sources.note: Avid HD I/O Guide v8.1 (opened, PDF text read and the two panel illustrations on p.5 and p.7 extracted locally): front panel = power button with LED ring, sample-rate and sync-mode LEDs, loop-master LED and 16x2 meters; back panel (8x8x8 configuration) = Bay 1 Analog In (two DB25: +4 dBu left, -10 dBV right), Bay 2 Analog Out (DB25), Bay 3 Digital I/O (AES/EBU DB25, TDIF DB25, ADAT optical, AES/EBU XLR in/out, S/PDIF RCA, WORD CLOCK and LOOP SYNC BNC in/out), Bay 4 empty, DigiLink EXPANSION and PRIMARY ports, ACCESSORY DB9, IEC inlet. The guide states no physical dimensions.

Rear panel illustration embedded in the same PDF (p.7, extracted locally, 863x168 px). Scale 1.775 px/mm from the rack-ear mounting slots (centres 823 px apart = 465.1 mm EIA spacing; vertical 136 px = 76.2 mm for the outer holes of a 2U). x from the left ear outer edge, y from the bottom edge; the picture is seen from behind, which is the outside of the io face. Expect +/- 4 mm.

Front panel illustration embedded in the same PDF (p.5, extracted locally, 867x243 px, front straight-on with the top surface visible). Scale 1.727 px/mm from the ear slots (131.6 px = 76.2 mm). power = round button with green LED ring; sample-rate = the 48 kHz LED of the SAMPLE RATE row (the real unit has no sample-rate control, the rate is set in Pro Tools and only shown on LEDs).
